title.pt: Casa futurista com torre na neve
title.de: Futuristisches Haus mit Turm im Schnee

generated.description: A tall, sleek futuristic house built mostly from quartz blocks, quartz slabs and black stained glass, with dark oak accents and a beacon on top. It stands roughly 57 by 63 blocks across and 29 blocks high, with a stepped, multi-tier layout that sits on dirt, snow and podzol. The build has a furnace and a beacon as block entities and no interior details are described in the source.
